_readme: Tip posts for the feed (post kit k2). Each tip needs a real photo from a live YardSwaps listing that PROVES the tip (the meter, the plate, the wear), in brand/posts/photos/<slug>.jpg, faces and plates checked by eye. tag = the fact you can read in the photo; headline = one plain instruction that fits one line; body = one line that says the same thing. make_tips.py renders brand/posts/out/<slug>-4x5.jpg and -9x16.jpg and names the listing in the corner only while it is still live. A tip marked held is not rendered: the critics (11-26) sent back every tip whose photo did not show the tip. Rules: plain advice a mechanic would agree with, no numbers we cannot back up, no promises of views or sales, never a stock or AI picture (Alan 11-26). Nothing here posts until Alan says go.

tips.headline: Show the hour meter.
tips.body: A clear photo of the meter backs up the hours in your listing.

headline: Ask for a
*cold start.
tips.body: Ask the seller not to run it before you get there. A cold engine shows how it really starts, idles and smokes.
tips.tip: Put your hand on the hood when you arrive. Warm means it already ran.
tips.held_why: k1 fields and a photo that does not show the tip; needs a photo that proves it, a tag, a one-line headline and a one-line body

headline: Show the
*whole machine.
tips.body: Shoot all four sides, the hour meter, the data plate and any wear. Clear photos answer questions before buyers ask.
tips.tip: Add a photo and the AI fills in the title, make, model and specs. You check it before it posts.
tips.held_why: k1 fields and a photo that does not show the tip; needs a photo that proves it, a tag, a one-line headline and a one-line body

headline: The data plate
*is the machine's ID.
tips.body: Make, model, serial number and year are stamped on it. Match the plate to the listing and the paperwork before you pay.
tips.tip: Selling? Put a clear photo of the plate in your listing.
tips.held_why: k1 fields and a photo that does not show the tip; needs a photo that proves it, a tag, a one-line headline and a one-line body

headline: Lead with
*the hours.
tips.body: Year, hours and condition are the first things a buyer asks. Put all three in the title or the first line.
tips.tip: Add a photo of the hour meter, so nobody has to take your word for it.
tips.held_why: k1 fields and a photo that does not show the tip; needs a photo that proves it, a tag, a one-line headline and a one-line body
